statement: node bench/gate.mjs --contamination, run as its own process, printed (exit 1): "CONTAMINATION RED: bar files (isTheBar true) 74 of 226 verdict files, with a split object 73, contaminated and labelled 14 (autopilot-board10.json, brief.json, census-prune.json, census.json, compress-board10.json, compress.json, daemon.json, math.json, public-launch.json, recall.json, senses.json, synth.json, unsplit-bars.json, web-ladder.json), contaminated and unlabelled 0, with no split 0, split not an object 1; CAUSES (1): 1 bar file(s) whose split is not an object: grid.json (string "training")". Of the eleven bar files this item was given (the row named them with no split when the board was written), 10 now carry a split stamped by tools/split-stamp.mjs (autopilot-board10.json, census-prune.json, census.json, code.json, compress-board10.json, compress.json, math.json, public-launch.json, synth.json, web-ladder.json) and 1 carry the split their own run wrote (census-scale-static.json); every stamped file gives its old bytes back by sha256 once the stamp is cut out, so no field its run wrote moved; the row now names 1 cause(s) over grid.json, 0 of them among the eleven. 10 of the eleven give a contamination reason in split.contaminated (autopilot-board10.json, census-prune.json, census-scale-static.json, census.json, compress-board10.json, compress.json, math.json, public-launch.json, synth.json, web-ladder.json); 9 of those are stamped, and the stamp told the reader: top-level contaminated true and one sentence appended to the statement, so the row lists 9 of the 9 as contaminated and labelled. 1 own run file(s) give a reason with no top-level mark, so the row reads them as clean (census-scale-static.json): a stamp never touches a split its own run wrote, and that writer is not this item's. The control, the gate's own row function over the 10 stamped files with their stamps cut out, counts 10 with no split. Bar MET: the bar asks that none of the eleven is a cause (0 named), that every cause left names grid.json, item ladder-arc's (0 other), that every stamp passes its check (0 failed) and that every stamped reason is labelled (9 of 9). Contaminated, as the split says: the scored records are the files this item wrote its stamps into, so the row measures that the rule is kept, not a held-out result.
